findings: The controller imports no TestPilot code and invokes only 34 explicitly admitted history CLI commands with -S -B, an empty PATH and a minimal environment.

All 45 frozen control identities were independently rehashed; all 34 literal expected stdout files and the complete case specification are among those preserved controls. Expected stdout admission is length/SHA-bound and result comparison is exact bytes.

Input/source namespace admission uses lstat, records directories, symlinks, regular files and FIFO without opening FIFO bodies, and binds declared hardlinks. Complete before/after namespace and control comparisons cover bytes, modes, mtimes, inode/device/link identities and link targets.

Prospective stdout/stderr files and separately owned process groups are used. A timeout, TERM/KILL cleanup, surviving process group, exit/output mismatch, preservation failure or controller exception cannot be relabeled accepted. Later independent cases continue after an ordinary failed case.
All case specification names and argv are admitted before execution, expected case count is 34, and full expected source leaf membership is checked.
limits: This review does not independently derive every literal expected report or claim their semantic correctness beyond the previously reviewed public contract; Anvil owns oracle authorship.
No candidate implementation body was read and no product or receiver command was run for this review.
The controlled owned filesystem is not treated as hostile or concurrently replaced; this is not a global network/process audit or power-loss/process-race guarantee.
Final preservation is an end-of-course observation; transient mutation restored byte-and-identity-exact is outside that observation.
scope: Complete read-only review of the independent CLI controller and criteria before candidate-body exposure; no execution of controller, fixtures or product.
